Title: Location by amo: The friend map is back | Product Hunt
# Location by amo. ## The friend map is back. Location by amo is the app that puts your friends on the map — from checking in on your crew to making moves to meetup. Brought to you by the original team behind location-sharing app Zenly. Launch tags:Social Network•Maps•Social Networking. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Location by amo. ElevenAgents by ElevenLabs — Scale conversations without scaling your team. Scale conversations without scaling your team. The Zenly team returns with #3 in their series of apps, following ID and Capture. There's clearly a strategy here, as these apps are being launched in sequence... how many apps will there be, total? And how will this strategy affect user adoption? Love the overall vision (definitely link to that! I cant find it anywhere), needed to learn more about how the app works before i go ahead and invite friends though. the welcome/onboarding video is the best I've ever seen 🔥 excited to see this reincarnated! Congrats, @chrismessina for the launch! It is a fantastic app for effortless meetups! As a graphic designer, the simplicity and efficiency of putting friends on the map appeal to me. Excited for seamless coordination with friends! As a frequent traveller my friends are sort of all over, so this kind of tool is particularly interesting! This product looks like a great way to stay connected with friends and family. Exciting to see something this unique and helpful! What's old is new again. What's the biggest difference from Zenly, @an21m?
